result.rationale: Ankle sprain 2 hours ago in a 36-year-old who could bear weight for four steps, with no midfoot pain and no medial malleolar tenderness, but with bony tenderness at the tip/posterior edge of the lateral malleolus — this is a positive Ottawa Ankle Rule criterion, so an X-ray is indicated to rule out fracture. No red flags (no open wound, numbness, deformity, or inability to bear weight) requiring urgent escalation; clinician should assess and arrange imaging. Meanwhile rest, ice, elevation, and avoid strenuous use.
